typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT BAT.BATCH_ID, MAST.REPT_ID, BATDET.SCHD_ID , MAST.REPT_ARCH, OUTP.AMCTR_DESC REPT_OUTP, OUTA.AMCTR_DESC REPT_OUTA, MAST.REPT_QUERY1, MAST.REPT_QUERY2  FROM AGP.MSB_REPORT_BAT BAT INNER JOIN MSB_REPORT_BAT_DET BATDET ON BAT.BATCH_ID = BATDET.BATCH_ID AND BATDET.BAT_DET_STS = 1 and REPT_STS = \'A\' and SCHD_STS = \'A\' INNER JOIN AGP.MSB_REPORT_MASTER MAST ON MAST.REPT_ID = BATDET.REPT_ID INNER JOIN AGP.MSB_MCTR_LKUP OUTP ON OUTP.AMCTR_ENTITY =\'REMA\' and OUTP.AMCTR_TYPE =\'OUTP\' and OUTP.AMCTR_VALUE = MAST.REPT_OUTP INNER JOIN AGP.MSB_MCTR_LKUP OUTA ON OUTA.AMCTR_ENTITY =\'REMA\' and OUTA.AMCTR_TYPE =\'OUTA\' and OUTA.AMCTR_VALUE = MAST.REPT_OUTA WHERE BAT.BATCH_ID = 0 Order by BATDET.SCHD_PRIORITY',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		{})) ~> OutputPlaceHolderReportRecordSet
